svg.title: Green Red Yellow Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Four separated portrait canvases in observed green/red/yellow/blue order. Museum supplies overall dimensions53x107in and each52.5x22.5in; differences in installation extent retained. Gaps approximate.
